content: Fabric 26.2 provides Fabric Loader JUnit for isolated logic and Minecraft GameTest for server gameplay, plus an experimental client GameTest API. Loom configureTests can create a separate gametest source set; server GameTests run with build, while client GameTests run through runClientGameTest and can capture screenshots. A short sprint should unit-test pure state machines and codecs, then use a few server GameTests for campaign and boss transitions.
